scripts.native:init: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-native.mjs && npx cap sync
scripts.native:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync && node scripts/configure-native.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run native:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run native:sync && npx cap open ios
